source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.5, printed page 309.

blocks.text: Ozone ek taqatwar oxidizing agent hai. Thori concentration (miqdar) mein yeh zehreeli nahi, lekin 100 parts per million (ppm) se zyada ho to zehreeli (toxic) hai. Yeh insanon, paudon aur doosri cheezon ko nuqsan deti hai, jaise rubber, kapre ke rang (fabric dyes), aur paint ki mazbooti aur shakal.

blocks.prompt: Ozone stratosphere mein hamari hifazat karti hai magar zameen ke qareeb nuqsan deti hai. Farq wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation: Stratosphere mein oonchai par ozone nuqsan-deh UV radiations ko zameen tak pohnchne se pehle jazb kar leti hai. Zameen ke qareeb yeh dhoop mein NOₓ aur VOCs se banne wala secondary pollutant hai, aur taqatwar oxidizing agent hone ki wajah se phephron, paudon, rubber, rangon aur paint ko nuqsan deti hai.

items: Low altitude ozone: taqatwar oxidizing agent; 100 ppm se oopar zehreeli; insan, paude, rubber, rang aur paint ko nuqsan.
